instr: Event order: watch a list of short events, then put them back in the order they happened.
clue: Short events appear one at a time. Remember their order. Then all of them appear as cards in a mixed order: tap the cards in the order the events appeared, first to last (or press the card numbers). Undo removes the last card. Press Done when all cards are placed. Press Start when ready.
phase_study: Remember the order of the events.
phase_test: Tap the events in the order they appeared, first to last. Backspace undoes, Enter finishes.
